values.AssociatedLNGNotes: A trade press article from September 2019 says NextDecade and Enbridge would develop the Rio Bravo pipeline to carry natural gas to the Rio Grande LNG export terminal in Brownsville. A 2016 Federal Register notice of the joint application names Rio Grande LNG and Rio Bravo Pipeline Company together. The Energy Information Administration also lists the line as feedstock supply for Rio Grande LNG.

verifications.note: Says the Rio Bravo pipeline will carry gas to NextDecade's Rio Grande LNG export terminal in Brownsville.
Notice of application filed jointly by Rio Grande LNG and Rio Bravo Pipeline Company.

records.researcher_notes: The sheet already had yes and a misspelled terminal name. The terminal name now matches the terminal list and refs are added. The Enbridge project page in the existing refs returns 404 today and was left alone.

ledger.note: Rio Bravo is the dedicated feed gas line for Rio Grande LNG per a 2019 trade press article, a 2016 Federal Register notice, and EIA text.
Searched Roadrunner Phase 1 coverage. Sources describe gas from the Permian to Mexican power and industrial customers, with no LNG export tie.
Phase 2 is a capacity expansion of the same line to Mexico. No source ties it to LNG export.
Phase 3 is on hold. No source ties it to LNG export.
The Cheyenne Hub Enhancement adds west to east capacity on the Rockies Express system. No source found ties it to LNG export.
The project serves Colorado Springs Utilities as it retires coal plants. No LNG tie found in the Federal Register notice or search results.
The lateral serves a planned power plant and an Archer Daniels Midland plant in Decatur, Illinois. No LNG tie.
The Rockies Express mainline carries Rockies gas east. LNG talk, if any, is company-wide and no source ties this line itself to a terminal, so it stays blank.
